paragraphs.text: # dsh-plugin-memory
**English** ｜ 中文
> Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — a portable markdown memory store with a soul, injected at
every session start.
**macOS · Windows · Linux** · Node ≥ 18 · DSH `^0.2.1-rc.5` · MIT
## What it does
A Cordis plugin that gives DSH agents **persistent, cross-session, migratable memory**: plain markdo
wn + git (the *LLM Wiki* pattern), a `SOUL.md` persona, and a boot block **auto-injected through run
time context** — a hard guarantee, not a hope that the model decides to call a skill.

## Features
- **Remembering across sessions** — boot block = SOUL + MEMORY protocol + `index.md` + recent activi

ty, with a per-file budget so the index tail is not truncated first.
- **A soul, not just storage**
— SOUL + BOOTSTRAP forging; a quick-setup card writes a managed block; persona names are read from S

OUL, never hard-coded.
- **You stay in control** — per-session switch (chip / `/memory on|off` / pan

el) and `disabledWorkspaces` defaults.
- **A companion** — digest nudge, proactive recall, weekly gr

owth recap, context-sensitive tone; shared speech floor with other proactive plugins.
- **Portable**

— plain markdown + git, `pack`/`unpack`, optional auto-commit.
- **Memory graph** — interactive 3D
sphere: rotate / zoom / drag nodes, search-to-focus, hover or click to light up neighbours; select a

node → **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**.
- **Health tools** — dashboard, `checkup`, `lint`, `d

octor`, automatic `last_access` stamping.
- **Zero build, bilingual panel, hot-editable config.**
## Screenshots
**Basic soul (quick forging)** — set the agent's name, what it calls you and a baseline persona in o
ne save; the next session uses it, no restart. Chat-forged souls are echoed back from `SOUL.md`.
**Memory graph (3D)** — a live projection of the store: rotate / wheel-zoom / drag nodes to arrange,
search-to-focus (the camera flies to the hit), hover or click to light up the neighbourhood. Select
a node to **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**; double-click empty space to reset.
**Settings panel** — sixteen settings apply immediately (per-session switch, boot gates, recall cade
nce, tone, disabled workspaces…). The health dashboard and the graph sit right below.
## Cross-platform
**macOS, Windows and Linux are supported.** Path settings expand `~`, `~\`, `%USERPROFILE%` and `$HO
ME`; CRLF files are parsed as LF and **written back with their own newline style**; *Reveal in Finde
r* maps to `open -R` (macOS), `explorer /select,` (Windows, space-safe argv) and `xdg-open` (Linux);
`disabledWorkspaces` matching is case-insensitive on Windows. Details: docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
## Configuration
Sixteen hot keys edit live under **Settings → Memory**. The full table, boot-budget rules and compos
ition overrides are in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

## Docs
Configuration · Design notes · Migration · Proactive protocol · Contributing · Security · Changelog
## FAQ
**Does it burn tokens every request?** No — runtime context is deduplicated by projection; an unchan

ged payload is injected once.
**File skill vs plugin?** The file skill is a soft guarantee (only its
blurb is injected); this plugin is a hard one. They coexist (the file skill ranks higher); remove a

ny hand-written persona to avoid double injection.
**Where should the store live?** `~/.memory` by d
efault; point `memoryDir` inside a project for isolation.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
